findings.title: Protective relation changes social position
findings.claim: The focus's reciprocal protective relation can place a person in the social position and practical obligations of the bloc they empower, so the resulting belonging is more than an added acquaintance.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers for part-to-part relation and w-l-y are returned through wider passages where wrongdoers are assigned to one another by their acquired acts, mutual protection is bounded by obligations, and reciprocal support is joined to shared practice; that contact changes the reading of protection into social incorporation.
findings.reader_payoff: The phrase about being from them becomes perceptible as a change in operative standing, not a claim that every ordinary contact erases distinction.
findings.containment: The finding does not condemn every mutual relation or identify one exhaustive translation of w-l-y. The wider target texts lack supplied target morphology, so their contribution remains qualified.

epistemic.reason: The focus finding is trusted and exactly anchored, while the wider connections provide supplied Arabic and relation notes without full target-side morphology.

findings.title: The addressed identity is maintained
findings.claim: The faith-qualified address admits a contained commitment resonance: the addressed identity is a lived acceptance that can be redirected by a party's influence, not only a fixed group label.
findings.mechanism: The focus faith carrier meets 3:100, which places obedience to a party beside reversal after faith; the contact makes the opening address and the later alignment warning part of one maintained orientation.
findings.reader_payoff: The address to believers becomes newly perceptible as an active condition of how one responds to competing allegiance.
findings.containment: This does not deny the audience's stated faith or claim that every social influence reverses it. The branch is a contained contextual resonance.

epistemic.reason: The focus carrier and wider target are supplied, but the activation is an authoring inference and target morphology is not supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus faith form carries entering and remaining attached to a committed path.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 3:100 warns that obedience to a party can turn believers back after faith.
branch_activations.activation: The reversal warning gives the focus address a maintained-commitment dimension that meets the later allegiance choice.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The addressed identity remains tied to how faith is lived when another party exerts influence.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made that the faith branch replaces the focus's direct address or names every form of belief.

friction_notes: The focus alignment is complete, but wider target records do not supply target-side morphology; connection-derived activations remain qualified.
Legacy summaries without a concrete returning carrier-trigger trace were excluded or bounded, while the exact 5:32 trace was retained with attributed context branches.
Same-pericope material was kept out of the global findings; the unsupported h-d-d image has no supplied carrier or connection.
Unowned branch findings preserve independently grounded surprises without treating branch availability as activation or ranking any reading.
